name: 90291 · Venice, CA
findings: ZIP 90291 (Venice) has 163 nonprofit organizations. 80 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 63 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90291 (Venice) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90291 (Venice) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
